display_long_description:
# Mind your footwork, and let’s tango!

Use your legs as your joystick. Use your bullets as your cover. Keep firing, keep moving, and break out of the bullet hell in your own living room!

**Bullet Hell IRL** brings mixed reality mayhem to heroes with bulletproof confidence. Now it’s your turn to step in: defeat waves of bullet-spewing monsters, carve paths through impossible walls of bullets, and challenge other players online or locally.

[media]

# Move to Survive
  
Step, lean, and reposition in your real space to dodge incoming fire. Your body is the controller. Standing still won't help you dodge.

[media]

# Shoot the Bullets
  
Enemy bullets aren't just hazards. They're targets. If you can't dodge a bullet, shoot it. Use your bullets as cover because shots can cancel each other out upon collision.

[media]

# Solo Arena
  
Face relentless waves of bullet-spewing monsters and see how long you can last. Blast through walls of bullets with your Gatling gun, then slip through narrow gaps in the storm.

[media]

# Duel Match
  
Duel with other players in your own living room, online or locally. The ultimate test of movement skills, strategic foresight, and bulletproof confidence!

[media]

# Early Access, Heroic Future

Launching in Early Access means you can jump in now and help shape the game with your feedback. We're building this together with our players, so suit up and join us on day one!
